TextView.android:text: This course covers two aspects of programming i.e. solving the problem using different techniques like algorithm, flowchart and decision table and then writing the programs using the syntax of Python language to obtain the computer solution to the problem. Python is a simple and easy to understand language. It is a great language to start as a beginner and then to scale up to professional programmer. This course will help enhancing the problem solving skills of the undergraduate student using the python language.
Program Planning: Problem solving concepts, design, debugging, error types, documentation.
Problem Solving Techniques: Flowcharting, decision tables, algorithms, structured programming, top-down and bottom-up approaches.
Python Introduction: Python program structure, elements, interpreter, basic operations, indentation, identifiers, literals, strings, operators.
Conditionals and Loops: Branching, looping, conditional statements, exit function, break, continue, and pass differences.
String Handling: String manipulation, basic operations, string slices, functions, and methods.
Lists: List introduction, operations, functions, and methods.
Tuples: Tuple introduction, operations, functions, and methods.
Dictionaries: Dictionary introduction, operations, functions, and methods.
Functions: Defining, calling, types, arguments, anonymous functions, global/local variables, code organization.
Modules: Organizing projects into modules, importing own/external modules, understanding packages.
Input-Output: Printing, keyboard input, file handling, functions.
Exception Handling: Introduction, handling exceptions, try-finally clause, user-defined exceptions.
